title: The MacRumors Show: iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 Are Coming
content:
On this week's episode of The MacRumors Show, we take a look at Apple's upcoming iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2, which are expected to launch in early 2027.

Subscribe to The MacRumors Show YouTube channel for more videos

Apple is expected to introduce the ‌iPhone 18‌ and iPhone 18e in February or March, with the ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 potentially following slightly later. The releases will complete Apple's split launch cycle, following the iPhone 18 Pro, ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, and iPhone Duo this fall.

The ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 is shaping up to receive the most substantial changes. A 48-megapixel Ultra Wide camera is expected to join the existing Fusion camera, with leaked dummy models showing the two lenses arranged horizontally across the camera plateau. The addition would address one of the original ‌iPhone Air‌'s most visible drawbacks: having fewer rear cameras than the cheaper standard iPhone.

Other rumored upgrades include a 3,500mAh battery, making it approximately 11% larger than the original model's, the A20 Pro chip, and vapor chamber cooling. Analyst Jeff Pu expects the device to retain its 6.5-inch display, 12GB of memory, and 18-megapixel Center Stage front camera, while gaining Apple's C2 modem and N2 wireless chip.

Earlier reports suggested a thinner, brighter display could help accommodate a larger battery, but more recent reporting points to unchanged display specifications so Apple can use existing OLED panel inventory.

The changes follow reports of weak demand for the original ‌iPhone Air‌. Apple has reportedly considered a lower price for its successor, which could help distinguish it from the Pro models while making its thin design more accessible.

The standard ‌iPhone 18‌ is expected to retain a broadly similar design to the iPhone 17, with a 6.3-inch display and two rear cameras. Its main upgrades are likely to include an A20 chip, Apple's C2 modem, and more memory. Both the A20 and A20 Pro are expected to use a 2nm manufacturing process for improved performance and efficiency.

Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo predicts 9GB of RAM for the ‌iPhone 18‌, while Pu expects 12GB and a smaller Dynamic Island. A 9GB configuration would reportedly remain below the memory requirement for enhanced on-device dictation and controls for Siri's vocal expressiveness and pace.

A purported internal diagram points to a 4,430mAh battery shared by the ‌iPhone 18‌ and iPhone 18e, with changes to the standard model's speaker and haptic engine creating additional space. A separate report suggests the device could also gain higher display brightness.

The iPhone 18e is also expected to receive the A20 chip and 9GB of RAM, while retaining a 60Hz display and single 48-megapixel rear camera. A front-camera upgrade has also been rumored.

Its appearance could change with a new iPad Pro-style housing that groups the lens, microphone, and flash. Reports disagree on whether its display will remain approximately 6.1 inches or grow to 6.3 inches.

Recent CAD leaks also suggest thicker camera housings on the ‌iPhone 18‌ and ‌iPhone Air‌ 2. Meanwhile, ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 dummy models appear to retain the current ‌Dynamic Island‌, contradicting earlier predictions of a smaller cutout.

We also touch on Apple's expected (PRODUCT)RED releases: a red HomePod mini 2, silver AirPods Max 2 with a red Digital Crown, an Apple Watch Sport Band, and an AirPods Pro Wrist Strap. A red AirTag has also reportedly been developed.
